device.demod: internal ALi M3503 / M3511B DVB-S2 (NIM_S3503_0 at 0xB8028000)

simulator.note: Boots as a 128 MB M3503 revision B board (chips/m3503.py, run_dump_micro_hd_se_app_starts.py, run_dump_micro_hd_se_capture_screen.py): the XIP bootloader ("M3511B 1.1.1") runs from flash using CacheAsRam at 0x8FFF8000..0x8FFFFFFF before relocating to DDR, prints "CH455 panel init OK!", writes " ON " to the CH455 panel on GPIO 135 / 134, parks the SEE boot stub at 0xA1416804, unpacks seecode ("M3606 SEE") to 0x86000200 and maincode(AV) ("10010A882483") to 0x80000200, and starts both cores (main EBase 0x80002000, SEE EBase 0x86002001).  The application prints "---led 455 attach OK--" and updates the CH455 panel to " on ", initialises its MCAS database and userdb(64+64) from defaultdb(PRC) over SPI, and renders its 1280x720 CLUT8 OSD through GeM36F / GMA layer 0 (without the board's anti-clone security IC it displays the hardware-ID warning dialog).

desc: Amiko Micro HD SE (System ID 10010A88) firmware v.2483 (2020-01-17) for the compact Full HD DVB-S2 satellite receiver on the ALi M3511B / M3503 rev B SoC with 128 MB DDR3 and 8 MB SPI flash.

Uses an XIP CacheAsRam bootloader ("M3511B 1.1.1"), dual-CPU "M3606 SEE" firmware at 0x86000200, an external CH455 4-digit LED / IR sensor eye on GPIO 135 (SCL) / 134 (SDA), and the Amiko 0x60xx remote control table ("necfirst" coding).
